opennyai_summary.decision:
Learned counsel for the appellant files a memo dated 04.09.2025 for withdrawal of the appeal contending that the matter was settled out of the Court between the parties, in Ex.No.207/2019, on the file of the IV Additional District and Sessions Judge, Channarayapatna and also to refund the statutory deposit amount of Rs.25,000/- in favour of the appellant.
Being satisfied with the grounds urged in the memo, the appeal is dismissed as withdrawn as settled out of the Court.
Office is directed to refund the statutory deposit amount of Rs.25,000/- in favour of the appellant.
Pending Interlocutory Applications, if any, stands disposed off.
